question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which was your favorite part of the episode?
Have you ever been bullied at school?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Your motorcycle drives crooked...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And your Anaconda races like a turtle!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: No one calls my baby `slow` and lives!
nodes.text_bbcode: No one calls my baby [color=#3b78e2][i]slow[/i][/color] and lives!

nodes.text: Megan pummels Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ow, ow, ow!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not the stomach! Oooof!
Later...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Way to go, little buddy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: W-what'd we do that for?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Half of getting bullies to leave you alone is showing them you have some spine. Want another punch?
Colt pounds his fist against his palm.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See? You didn't even cringe. Great job.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on. Time for step two of your training.
And a couple awkward moments later...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, aren't you going to say anything?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You're really starting to freak me out.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: All right, kid, you win. I'm going to...Put my car back together.
Colt walks over.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What was that? What were you `doing?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What was that? What were you [color=#e23b3b][i]doing?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I tried insulting her, but... It didn't work.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That made `me` want to punch you.
nodes.text_bbcode: That made [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] want to punch you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I wanted to teach you how to take a hit, not have a staring contest! You're hopeless!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I didn't know what to say

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have learned nothing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on. Time for step two of your training.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You drive an Anaconda!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah? So?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's a fact, not an insult...
And a couple minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So then I started racing my motorcycle backwards on the track!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Awesome! I didn't know you could do that!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Anyway, kid, you've taken up enough time. I'm going to go put my car back together.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, Megan! It's been delightful!
Colt walks over.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'It's been delightful'?! What was that? You're trying to make her mad, not marry her!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I tried insulting her, but... It didn't work.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That made `me` want to punch you.
nodes.text_bbcode: That made [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] want to punch you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I asked you to insult her. You `want` to get punched!
nodes.text_bbcode: I asked you to insult her. You [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to get punched!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I wanted to teach you how to take a hit, not have a tea party!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have learned nothing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on. We're moving on. Time for step two of your training.
Erik leans forward.
Megan shoves him back.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ew, ugh! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hurl another insult!
Erik takes a swing at Megan!
Megan sidesteps the punch, grabbing his fist.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ha ha, kid. That's a terrible swing!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But at least you put some muscle into it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let me try again...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Start talking, kid. Because I don't like your face.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And you know what I do to faces I don't like...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Re-shape 'em!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Er...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're not really a rebel! You just pretend to be one!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Come closer and say that to my face!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What should I do next?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're such a loser! Everyone says so.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Uh, that Prince Prix trophy on the tool chest there says otherwise. Besides, do I `look` like I care what people say?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, that Prince Prix trophy on the tool chest there says otherwise. Besides, do I [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] like I care what people say?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Get to the point, kid.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What should I do next?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Quit staring at me like that! It's creeping me out.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What should I do next?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think your hair is... Messy?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: My hair? It always looks like this.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And your, uh, your face is... Oily!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yup. That would be pure performance-grade 10W-30. Just gave the ol' girl her 100K spill and fill.
Erik looks at Colt helplessly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Try calling her a name!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think you're a...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think your car is... Ugly!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What was that, punk?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's right, go for the low blow! Call her a name!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And I think you're a...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, what do you have to say?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My three-step method is simple. One, fear no pain. Two, fear no conscience. Three, fear no fear. Got that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How do you 'fear no fear'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You figure that out as you go along. Anyway, lessons start now. Come on, let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: B-but we're in detention!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Here's a life lesson for free... You don't always have to listen to what other people tell you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Except for me. You should always listen to me.
Colt nudges Erik out the door.
Erik follows Colt into auto shop where the rebels are busy welding and putting cars together.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, guys...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Got kicked out of detention that fast, huh?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's called sneaking out, wise guy.
Colt turns to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, little buddy. Here's the first lesson.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I want you to start a fight.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A fight?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: With Megan.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't hit a girl! They're symbols of beautiful fragility!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? This symbol can crush your skull with her bare hands.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of the two of you, betting money's on her to take `you` out, so I wouldn't worry too much about that.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of the two of you, betting money's on her to take [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] out, so I wouldn't worry too much about that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She's going to hurt me? But I don't know how to defend myself!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, yeah. Defending yourself isn't what this lesson is all about. You're not learning to fight back.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This lesson is about `pain.` You're never going to make it far in life if you can't take a hit.
nodes.text_bbcode: This lesson is about [color=#e23b3b][i]pain.[/i][/color] You're never going to make it far in life if you can't take a hit.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you're never going to get rid of those bullies if all you think about is how much it's going to hurt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So go out there and make Megan mad!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That doesn't `seem` smart. But you did tell me I could trust you... Okay, I'll do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: That doesn't [color=#e23b3b][i]seem[/i][/color] smart. But you did tell me I could trust you... Okay, I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do I say?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Insult her! Call her names! Try to offend her!
Erik walks over to where Megan is working on her car.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'm busy here. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Hello, Megan. My name is Erik. I'm new here, and I... I...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeesh, this is going to take forever.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course it does.
Colt smacks Erik upside the head!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which is why when someone tells you something that sounds that great, you shouldn't trust them. Pre-lesson number one.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But you don't have to worry. You have something I want, and that means you can trust me. For now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good. Never trust anyone with a four-letter name. That means you can't trust Ryan, and you can't trust me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But `I` have a four-letter name.
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] have a four-letter name.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, then, you can't trust yourself then, can you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You've got some street smarts in you, little buddy. And that I can work with.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For now, though, you can trust me because you have something I want...
Erik flails his arms about, and his wrist collides with Ryan's nose.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, watch it, twig!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Just what is going on here?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: We were, uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They were going to throw me in!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Watch what you say, chump.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: You boys know very well there's no fighting or bullying at school!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: All of you, detention, now!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I wasn't even the one who initiated battle...
In detention hall...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Erik, I know you're new, but that doesn't mean I can go easy on you. The rules at Centerscore are clear. There is no fighting on campus.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: If you want to avoid detention, you should probably make better friends.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But they're not my friends...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Anyway, here in the music room, you'll be cleaning all the instruments for the music students. Good luck. Another student will be along if you have any questions.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: He's a regular.
Ms. Prez leaves Erik alone inside the music room.
Erik eyes the walls of instruments.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There are so many! I'll be here all night!
Suddenly, the door slams open, and Colt storms in.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll show Mrs. Faulkner terrible math grades!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Someone who's not in the mood to deal with you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You kick a desk once, and you get sent to detention!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why'd you kick a desk?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Turns out you can't go to the dance thing unless you get a passing grade in math. My girlfriend's going to flip when she finds out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And what are you staring at? What are you in for?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I... Got into a fight.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait a minute, wide-brimmed glasses... Small and delicate physique... The lingering aroma of dumpster...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're a nerd!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah. Not a fantasy nerd, but I really `love`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. Not a fantasy nerd, but I really [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, so when you say 'got into a fight', you mean you got 'beat up'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Affirmative.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, nerd, I have an idea. You're getting beat up. I need a better math grade. There's an easy answer here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're going to protect me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You kidding me? You have a punchable face. I don't have time to go around stopping every bully that wants to beat on you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But what I `can` do is teach you how to defend yourself. With Colt's foolproof, three-step method, you'll be facing down bullies in no time!
nodes.text_bbcode: But what I [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] do is teach you how to defend yourself. With Colt's foolproof, three-step method, you'll be facing down bullies in no time!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you say, little buddy?

options.label: How do I know I can trust you?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Haha, like I haven't heard that one before.
Ryan roughly grabs Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Agh! What have I ever done to you?!
Ryan punches Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: We're going outside.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Nerds go in the dumpster!
Ryan lifts Erik into the dumpster!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Shields what?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What's he talking about?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe I can escape!
Erik runs outside, but Ryan roughly grabs him!
Ryan punches Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Nice try distracting us with your `words,` but...
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice try distracting us with your [color=#e23b3b][i]words,[/i][/color] but...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Nerds go in the dumpster!
Ryan lifts Erik into the dumpster!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Glad you agree.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, er, wait! I meant... I'll fight you!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: No more words. Words are dumb. Let's get this fight started.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, that's what I was going to say next!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Let's get this fight started.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I have nothing more to teach you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Do I get a belt or something?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! You get to prevent yourself from a life filled with internal bleeding!
At that moment, Ryan and $Travis run around the corner.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Looks like your training is going to come in handy right about now... Good luck, kid.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're not staying?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nah. If anyone knew I helped a nerd, they'd think I cared or something.
Colt runs off.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: There he is!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, nerd. We were looking for you! You're the one that got us in detention!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: We're going to throw you in the dumpster!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: But first I'm gonna rearrange your teeth!

nodes.prompt: What do you say to that?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you say to that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You didn't master any fighting techniques.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You didn't master the lesson of pain.
Suddenly, the light from a police patrol car flashes across the bridge!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: All right, stop right there, you two! This is Officer Monte!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Officer Monte again? Is there only `one` law enforcer in town?
nodes.text_bbcode: Officer Monte again? Is there only [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] law enforcer in town?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Stay right there!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay! I'm staying! I'm staying!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Have I taught you nothing?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is where `fear no fear` begins. If you can run from the police, you can face down anything!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is where [color=#e23b3b][i]fear no fear[/i][/color] begins. If you can run from the police, you can face down anything!

nodes.text: Colt starts sprinting.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This way!
Erik spray paints 'Erik Ericson Rules!' in big, bold letters!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's great...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you want the cops to know exactly who's been here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Want to put your address up there, too, in case they didn't get it the first time?
Erik spray paints 'Star Tracks Rules!' in big, bold letters!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What is Star Tracks?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Only the best TV show in the history of time! The crew of the star ship, the 'Undertaking', goes through space...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: 'To audaciously travel where no being has trekked before!'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You sound as excited as a squealing girl when she sees a cute puppy in human clothes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, so it's not exactly cool, but at least it's not your name.
Some time later...
Erik awakes to Colt slapping him in the face!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What? Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You got taken out by Skazz.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He made you look like a rag doll.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... Should I try it again?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No way! The first time was embarrassing enough!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Besides, as dumb as Skazz is, he's not going to fall for that trick a second time...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We're moving on.
After a quick walk, Erik and Colt stand under a bridge near the skatepark.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So what's step three?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Step three. Fear no fear!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Am I going to face down each of my fears?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's awesome... But how are we going to get a shark into a pool?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Face down each of your fears? That would take forever. Instead, we're going to spray paint this bridge.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But it's... It's illegal to mark public property!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So is trespassing, but we've already violated that rule.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We have?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yep, you can't hop a fence these days without bothering `someone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yep, you can't hop a fence these days without bothering [color=#e23b3b][i]someone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Besides, graffiti is the first step to becoming a true man.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I thought that was shaving...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Live and learn, little buddy.
Colt tosses Erik a bottle of spray paint.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever you want. I don't care as long as you're scared out of your mind while you're doing it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I am!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm thrilled.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I could write my name... Or I could spray paint something I'm interested in!
And sees Skazz winding up!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Lights out, sucker.
Skazz punches Erik hard in the head!
And everything goes black!
Erik takes a punch...
But misses!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ack!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Run away, kid!
Erik tries to run, but feels a hand clamp down on his shoulder.
Erik turns and looks up at Skazz...
Erik takes a punch...
But misses!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ack!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Run away, kid!
Erik tries to run, but feels a hand clamp down on his shoulder.
Erik turns and looks up at Skazz...
Erik punches Skazz!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Ughnhhh...
Skazz drops like a rock!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not bad, kid. Not bad at all.
Erik takes a punch...
But misses!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ack!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Run away, kid!
Erik tries to run, but feels a hand clamp down on his shoulder.
Erik turns and looks up at Skazz...
Erik does nothing!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, window's gone kid!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Run away! Before he...
Erik tries to run, but feels a hand clamp down on his shoulder.
Erik turns and looks up at Skazz...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, you've got him where you want him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is your window, kid. Now end it! Quick, punch him in the gut!
Erik pulls at Skazz's hair, but it slips out of his grasp!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why'd you go for the hair? This isn't a girl fight!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You've left yourself wide open!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I have?
Erik turns and looks up at Skazz...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't just stand there! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Watch out!
Erik looks up at Skazz...
Erik knees Skazz in the groin!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Aghhhhh! Not cool, nerd!
Skazz doubles over!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good, now finish him off!
Erik pulls at his own hair in frustration.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What am I doing?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Eyes up, hands out of your hair! You idiot, you're wide open!
Erik turns and looks up at Skazz...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't just stand there! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Watch out! Run!
Erik tries to run, but feels a hand clamp down on his shoulder.
Erik turns and looks up at Skazz...
Erik pulls at Skazz's hair, but it slips out of his grasp!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why'd you go for the hair? This isn't a girl fight!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you've left yourself wide open!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I have?
Erik turns and looks up at Skazz...
Erik knees Skazz in the groin!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Aghhhhh! Not cool, nerd!
Skazz doubles over!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Good, now finish him off!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't just stand there! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Watch out!
Erik looks up at Skazz...
Erik throws dirt into Skazz's eyes!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Ow, what gives! Ow, ow!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice work, nerd!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now that he's distracted, go for his weak spot!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: His what?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pick someplace he's vulnerable and attack it!
Erik takes off his shirt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, that was definitely `surprising...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that was definitely [color=#e23b3b][i]surprising...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! This just got `weird.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, whoa, whoa! This just got [color=#e23b3b][i]weird.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is `not` the type of distraction we want! Put your shirt back on!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] the type of distraction we want! Put your shirt back on!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do I do now?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You still have to hit him. It's just going to be harder.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pick someplace he's vulnerable and attack it!
Erik stands, frozen in fear!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Standing there and looking pathetic isn't an option!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uhm, er... What should I do?!

nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.text: `Owwwww!`

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So, same time tomorrow? If you bring me your lunch money, I won't turn your face into an omelet.

nodes.text: But how will I acquire food?

nodes.text: You look like you got run over by a truck.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ryan and $Travis beat me up.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: T-they did? Really?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why do you look so happy?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm free! Now that the bullies think you're the weakest nerd in the group, they're going to go after you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's not a good thing!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Erik. Really, I am.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But it's been a long time since I haven't had to walk down the hallways in fear of getting stuffed in a locker...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Or shaken down for my lunch money...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Or being pantsed in front of all the students at lunch and assemblies!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The point is... You've freed me.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm like Atlas as the weight of the world is lifted from his shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not sure what that means exactly.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I guess if you've been suffering for the last couple years... You probably deserve a break.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Someone else should probably take your place... Someone like me.
This isn't how Erik wants to live for the next four years!

nodes.text: That didn't hurt at all!

nodes.text: I did it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You did the Colt method proud today. Good job, little buddy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What did I tell you about wussy cheers?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for everything, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure thing.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: As the Bulcans from Star Tracks say... 'Stay healthy and thrive!'
Erik salutes Colt in the Bulcan way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: One final tip... Don't ever do that again. I'll see you around, kid.
Erik Ericson stood up to the bullies and had a great first day!
Now that's a knock-out win for everyone! You played a great game!

nodes.text: Come with me, boys.
In Monte's patrol car...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm hauling you two Clydes to Boot Camp.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not this time. I won't be taken again!
Colt tears at the door handle, flings the door open, and rolls out of the moving car!

nodes.text: Hey! Stop!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Knew I should've locked that.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh well, I'm just hauling you to Boot Camp then.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, Erik, you're free to go.

nodes.text: It's been a long time since I've seen the sunlight, but I'll be sure to savor it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I have to thank you, Monte. Being institutionalized has taught me a lot about the world.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You've only been in here for a week.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And yet I've learned so much... How to survive, how to push rocks, how to be a man.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, just put those skills to good use in school and...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: School?! I'm never going back there.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: All school means is more bullying, more detention, more stuff I don't want to do.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm making my way in the world. I'll never finish school!
Erik walks off into the distance.
Erik's changed as a person because he went to Boot Camp for a week? This isn't what he would've wanted!

nodes.text: Your second lesson is about your conscience. I'm about to teach you how to fight.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Like in 'The Aikido Kid'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, not like that at all. That movie's all about honor and fighting with dignity.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: With biceps like yours, you can't afford to have honor or dignity.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Do as I do. Ignore that inner voice that says, 'This is wrong.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Scandinavia.

nodes.speaker: Colt

Skazz crosses the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Skazz! This kid said you were the dumbest dumb person to ever live!

Skazz runs over.

nodes.text: W-wait, I'm not ready for another encounter!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Please, this is Skazz. He gets beaten up accidentally. Besides, I'll be coaching you on the side.
Skazz towers above Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: First things first. Distract your opponent!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Do something surprising! Something that will catch him off guard.

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.title: How to Fight Nerdy
nodes.subtitle: Can you help a new nerd survive bullying at school?

nodes.text: It's Erik Ericson's first day as a freshmen at Centerscore High, and the nerds are showing him the ropes!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for showing me around, you guys.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ever since Spud and Kat graduated and Angie got a boyfriend, there just haven't been enough students around who actually care about doing as much extra credit as humanly possible.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And over here's the computer with the best connection for the fastest downloading speeds for Warscrewdriver Online!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What level are you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...I'm not really a high fantasy nerd. I actually prefer Star Tracks and Star Battles, but...
Ryan and Travis enter the library, and the other nerds scatter!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ryan and Travis at twelve o'clock!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Who are they?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Bullies. They always go for the weakest nerd. They used to beat up on this Brendan guy.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But since he went to the wrong side of town and had this crazy adventure there, they won't go within ten feet of him.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: He looks real mad. I heard he's upset that he doesn't have a date for the Valentine's Day Ball. We better get out of here.
Dex runs off.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, `nerd,` get over here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, [color=#e23b3b][i]nerd,[/i][/color] get over here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You see anyone else looking real pathetic over there? Yeah, you!
Cautiously, Erik walks over to Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Look, there's something I want to show you!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: A punch to the face!

Colt and Erik run across the bridge, through the skatepark, and back into Centerscore territory.
Erik and Colt sprint through the skatepark.

A couple minutes later...
Colt saunters up to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Back again?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Coming back to cash in.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cash in?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, thanks to me, little buddy, you learned some valuable lessons, and the bullies are going to leave you alone.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, that was great!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So I did my end of the deal. What about all that math homework you said you'd help me with?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You want me to tutor you? I'd be happy to!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No... I just need to see your homework for an hour so I can... Double-check my work.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Er, okay, sure thing!
Colt takes Erik's homework and runs off!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, nerd! I just talked with Mrs. Faulkner about my math grade, and she says everything on my math homework is wrong!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: To tell you the truth...

Looks like Erik's in Colt's debt! How will he return the favor?
